>Add synchronization for overall VPD collection completion handling.

Why is synchronization required for overall VPD collection status?
Once overall collection is done, the infinite loop in this API should exit and then we can do the post all VPD collection processing.
agree, point-1 enough for exit condition, removed this line. post this api call completion status is handled.

Better name which tells what is the purpose?
m_chassisResultQueue? as your comment says it will have chassis result?

Having a counter here will work?

l_chassisToMotherboardEepromMap is captured and validated in this API every time whenever collectAllFruVpd is called. It is the right place to get the chassis count before launching threads to collect VPD asynchronously.

"l_chassisToMotherboardEepromMap.size()" does not guarantee that thread will be launched for all those chassis and if that happens where there is a mismatch in the number of threads actually launched and the size fetched here then the counter will never reach zero after it is decremented post chassis collection.

This will lead to a situation where collection status will never reach to a completion state.
As per the current flow this won't work.
